Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to Ragnaਕੰਟਰੋਲਰ! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-ਪੈਡ to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. ਦਬਾਓ 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. ਰੱਖੋ down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the ਅੱਧੇ ਸਟਿਕ slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? ਰਿਕਾਰਡ your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline ਸੰਪਾਦਿਤ ਕਰੋor. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
